scope: Six MW-NEXT candidates and metadata-only native SQLite version correction; no ledger edits or new PASS claims.

candidates.reviewer_note: Actual Root/Child Agent Start exercises denied Create, stale pre-admission control winner, duplicate original Run, and a changed ModelNext RunID; Child additionally exercises original complete-request/ancestor StartControlPreflight rejection. Each exact typed denial preserves original self/ancestor source and authority and sends zero Model/Tool work. Foreign ModelNext is rejected after admission, not misrepresented as zero middleware entry. Public API supplies no independent caller-authentication input; no Host authentication claim.
candidates.actual_backends: Memory/retained-store fresh-owner; nativeSQLite-v5/independent handles with all-handles-close-reopen for P2/P4; auxiliary GORM-SQLite/shared-DB fresh-wrapper; PostgreSQL16/independent pools and fresh recovery pool (original pools retained until cleanup)

candidates.reviewer_note: Actual admitted Run, Model and Tool middleware are held before their Next dispatch. Independent self/ancestor Cancel and ordinary Apply follow exact native-required/physical-busy/terminal precedence without snapshot, grant or epoch mutation. Double and retained Next closures reject ErrNextAlreadyCalled. Explicit native paths cover all three chains; default owner is an additional Run-chain vector, not all-chain/default Cartesian coverage. Successful whole callback settles exactly once.
candidates.actual_backends: Memory/retained-store fresh-owner; nativeSQLite-v5/independent handles with all-handles-close-reopen for P2/P4; auxiliary GORM-SQLite/shared-DB fresh-wrapper; PostgreSQL16/independent pools and fresh recovery pool (original pools retained until cleanup)

candidates.reviewer_note: Actual Root/Child Run, Model and Tool chains exercise admitted asynchronous Next, post-Next unknown error and panic; outer execution joins admitted Next before return. The swallowed-inner Model error uses a replacement context and an outer nil result: the Child now owns an independent Run/grant/source/operation-bound callback journal, so inner unknown cannot be erased or borrow its parent journal; Root unknown protection remains unchanged. Unknown cases retain the original grant/full source and receipts, with no committed Mark; fresh reconciliation cannot retire them, and retained Next remains rejected. Model unknown with a native lease also tests real expiry without authorizing replay. The original B21 FAIL remains historical evidence; final acceptance requires this source rerun and review, not rewriting the old failure.
candidates.actual_backends: Memory/retained-store fresh-owner; nativeSQLite-v5/independent handles with all-handles-close-reopen for P2/P4; auxiliary GORM-SQLite/shared-DB fresh-wrapper; PostgreSQL16/independent pools and fresh recovery pool (original pools retained until cleanup)

candidates.reviewer_note: Actual Model/Tool receipts are durable while the outer original Run callback is still executing after Next. Before whole callback return the marker count is zero; exact self/ancestor control fences and all retained Next closures preserve full source, receipts and grant. Only after the complete original callback returns may ordinary first-party Mark/Finish settle once. Receipt existence alone is not whole-callback completion and does not authorize synthesizing a missing marker.
candidates.actual_backends: Memory/retained-store fresh-owner; nativeSQLite-v5/independent handles with all-handles-close-reopen for P2/P4; auxiliary GORM-SQLite/shared-DB fresh-wrapper; PostgreSQL16/independent pools and fresh recovery pool (original pools retained until cleanup)

candidates.reviewer_note: The original Store Mark commits, then its wrapper loses the ACK and holds Finish. Child uses actual ReconcileChildPhysicalGrant once to reach the held Finish; Root follows its own existing recovery entry, not a Child marker substitute. Fresh recovery uses the original committed marker, removes that original grant, and does not replay Model, Tool or retained Next. Full original receipt/source snapshots are retained. SQLite closes both original handles before reopen; PostgreSQL opens a genuinely separate recovery pool, without claiming all pools closed or process restart.
candidates.actual_backends: Memory/retained-store fresh-owner; nativeSQLite-v5/independent handles with all-handles-close-reopen for P2/P4; auxiliary GORM-SQLite/shared-DB fresh-wrapper; PostgreSQL16/independent pools and fresh recovery pool (original pools retained until cleanup)

candidates.reviewer_note: Explicit entered/returned/release/done barriers hold admitted asynchronous Run, Model and Tool Next while an independent peer performs real Resume and self/ancestor control attempts. The competing Resume is rejected with exact ModelOutcomeUnknown or ToolOutcomeUnknown as applicable; original snapshots, grant, receipts and native authority are unchanged, and the original caller joins Next before settlement. Separate real Run/ancestor deadline vectors reject Expire while the physical scope is active and prevent new physical sends after the deadline. These are active-owner/contender schedules, not two successful recovery winners or durable Host cancellation elections; shared Host budget is not an input of this plugin/Agent fixture.

limits: No test or gate was run for this proposal. All notes await completed same-source evidence plus independent acceptance.
Root has empty OriginFingerprint; Child uses original parent and ancestor preflight. Source checks are not caller authentication.
Memory and auxiliary GORM retain process state; fresh wrappers are not restart durability. SQLite P2/P4 close all handles, but saved closures and Feature registries remain in process.
PostgreSQL uses independent pools and fresh recovery pool; this particular factory does not close all old pools before recovery.
Only 54 explicit nativeSQLite-v4 labels are proposed for literal version substitution. Other backend labels, reopen restrictions and Host/Kernel separation remain untouched.
SQLite CreateNew current schemaVersion=5 is a final-source implementation fact, not a claim that all old v4 evidence was run on v5. Historical receipts/logs are never rewritten.
